run_img2img_cli: run img2img.py with --init-img and --prompt to generate variations of an input image
run_img2img_from_file: run img2img.py with --from-file to load multiple prompts from a text file
run_img2img_custom_steps: run img2img.py with --ddim_steps and --strength to control denoising iterations and noise level
run_img2img_grid_skip: run img2img.py with --skip_grid to save only individual samples without a grid image
run_img2img_plms_sampler: run img2img.py with --plms flag to use the PLMS sampler instead of DDIM
